title: Centralize app_shell.dart / persistent_switcher_scaffold.dart color literals into AppTheme instead of scattering/duplicating hex values

evidence.quote: const barBackground = Color(0xFFF1F3FA); // opaque pale blue

why: app_shell.dart has 8 raw Color(0x...) literals and persistent_switcher_scaffold.dart has 1 more — all outside lib/core/theme/, exactly what the (currently non-functional, custom_lint is broken repo-wide) no_color_literal_outside_theme rule targets. Worse, the SAME hex value (0xFFF1F3FA, 'opaque pale blue') is hand-copied in both files as an unrelated local constant rather than a shared AppTheme token, and 0xFF0038A8 is a bespoke blue never defined in AppTheme at all (AppTheme.brandBlueDeep is a different value, 0xFF3F41AB). The file's own comments document this exact bar going through TWO rounds of contrast bugs ('Bug 7' and 'Bug 7 (re-fix)') — duplicated, untracked magic colors are precisely what makes a third recurrence likely, since a future contrast fix to one copy can silently miss the other.
recommendation: Move _tutorAccentColor, _childViewAccentColor, barBackground/barBorder, and the nav-item selected-color into AppTheme/AppColors named constants; have persistent_switcher_scaffold.dart reference the same constant app_shell.dart uses.
acceptance_criteria: All Color(0x...) literals in app_shell.dart and persistent_switcher_scaffold.dart are replaced with AppTheme/AppColors named constants.
Once custom_lint's analyzer-version incompatibility is fixed, `dart run custom_lint` reports zero no_color_literal_outside_theme violations in these two files.
0xFFF1F3FA exists as exactly one named constant referenced from both files.
